description: Preview (may change before v0.10.0): Build a versioned package and impact graph across 1-32 local repository checkouts from a reviewed JSON config. Resolves Node, Python, and Maven package versions plus manifest/import/submodule evidence without executing repository code. Use seeds to trace provider-to-consumer impact.

config.description: Local workspace JSON config path; repository paths inside it are relative to this file

format.description: Output format: markdown (default) or json, case-insensitive

noCache.description: Bypass the exact-state scan cache in every workspace repository

seeds.description: Repository IDs whose downstream consumers should be traced

name: fixmap_workspace
title: FixMap workspace
